Let's first combine the two basin exports.

```{python}
import pandas as pd

df_1 = pd.read_csv("data/results/2024-12-25-basin-export.csv")
df_2 = pd.read_csv("data/results/2025-01-14-basin-export.csv")

df_merged = (
  pd.concat([df_2, df_1])
  .drop_duplicates("id")
)

# there was only 1 answer after the first export
# the combined dataframe is just 1 line longer than the first dataframe
assert len(df_merged) == len(df_1) + 1 

# Save
df_merged.to_csv("data/results/full-basin-export.csv", index=False)

df_merged.head(3)
```
